settings.title: Settings
settings.noSchedules: No schedules configured. Global limit applies at all times.
settings.uploadExcludePatternsHint: Glob patterns matched against file names. Files matching any pattern are skipped during upload.
settings.noExcludePatterns: No exclude patterns configured. All selected files will be uploaded.
settings.fileLogEnabledDesc: Mirror logs to a rotating file. When disabled, logs only go to stdout.
settings.logDirectoryDesc: Leave empty to use the default location. Tilde (~) is expanded to your home.

versions.title: Object Versions
versions.unversionedHint: only the current version is listed
versions.noVersions: No version history for this object.

about.title: About
about.description: brows3r is a desktop application for browsing and managing S3-compatible object storage across cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure, OCI, DigitalOcean, Backblaze, Wasabi, Cloudflare R2, Scaleway, and more) and on-premise solutions (MinIO, Ceph, Dell ECS, NetApp StorageGRID).
about.author: Author

crossTransfer.title: Copy to Other Connection
crossTransfer.description: Copy {{count}} object(s) to another S3 connection via download + re-upload.

sync.title: Sync
sync.modeHint_new: Only files absent at the destination are copied. Never overwrites, never deletes.
sync.modeHint_updated: Also re-copies files that differ (size or stamped mtime). Never deletes.
sync.modeHint_mirror: Destination becomes an exact copy of the source. DELETES anything at the destination that's not at the source.
sync.confirmDeletes: I understand this plan will DELETE files/objects at the destination. I have reviewed the list above.

recovery.title: Interrupted uploads
recovery.description: {{count}} multipart upload(s) were interrupted. Resume them now or discard.
recovery.connectionRemoved: Connection no longer exists — only Discard is available.

versioning.statusSuspended: Versioning is suspended. Existing versions are kept, new writes are not versioned.
versioning.statusUnversioned: Versioning has never been enabled on this bucket.
versioning.description: When enabled, S3 keeps a copy of every object version, including deleted ones. Suspending keeps the existing history but stops creating new versions. S3 does not allow going back to "never versioned" once enabled.

encryption.description: When enabled, S3 automatically encrypts new objects with the chosen algorithm. Per-object encryption metadata on existing objects is not changed by switching the default.
encryption.bucketKey: Use S3 bucket key (reduces KMS request cost)
encryption.bucketKeyHint: Recommended for KMS encryption — has no effect with SSE-S3.

policy.statusAttached: A policy is attached to this bucket.
policy.description: Bucket policies grant or deny access via an IAM-like JSON document. They apply to every request that targets this bucket. Saving an invalid policy returns the S3 error inline.

cors.description: CORS rules let browsers running JavaScript from other origins make requests to this bucket. Each rule lists which origins, methods and headers are allowed. The server accepts up to 100 rules.
cors.empty: No rules. Add one to start.
cors.origins: Allowed origins (one per line, * matches all)
cors.errorNoMethods: Each rule must allow at least one HTTP method.
cors.errorNoOrigins: Each rule must allow at least one origin.

lifecycle.statusUnsupported: Lifecycle rules with advanced features detected.
lifecycle.unsupportedHint: Some rules use tag filters, size filters, AND combinations, or date-based transitions. The simplified editor doesn't represent them; editing is disabled to avoid losing data. You can still delete the entire configuration or refresh.
lifecycle.description: Lifecycle rules transition objects to colder storage classes or expire them after a number of days. The simplified editor covers the most common cases: prefix filter, day-based transitions, and noncurrent-version rules.
lifecycle.empty: No rules. Add one to start.

batch.title: Batch operations
batch.storageClassHint: Each object is rewritten in place via CopyObject. Existing metadata is preserved.
batch.aclHint: Applies the canned ACL to every selected object via PutObjectAcl.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.storageBreakdownHint: Compute stats on a bucket below to populate this chart.
dashboard.topBucketsHint: Compute stats on a bucket to start ranking.

dashboard.bucketsNoConnection: Pick a connection in the sidebar to see its buckets.
dashboard.truncatedHint: Scanned 50k objects; figures are a lower bound.
